name: web_screenshot
description: This tool allows you to capture a full-page PNG screenshot of a public web page rendered in a headless browser, returned as a base64 data URI. Use this tool when layout or visual appearance matters, such as verifying a rendering bug. Rendering waits for network idle up to a 20 second budget. The viewport defaults to 1280x800 and can be adjusted for responsive testing.

url.description: The absolute https URL to render.
